products.name: Gemini Connector Strategy & Agent Development Framework — Commercial
products.short_description: Define the connector strategy and agent-development framework for Gemini Enterprise — approved connectors with data-access boundaries and governed agentic-workflow development — so AI expands without ungoverned sprawl, pilot-first. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Govern the connectors and agents before they multiply

Gemini's value comes from connectors to enterprise data and agents that act — and both are risk surfaces if they're built ad hoc. This solution defines the connector strategy and agent-development framework for Gemini Enterprise: which connectors are approved and how data-access boundaries apply, and a governed framework for building agentic workflows safely — so AI capability expands without creating an ungoverned sprawl, deployed pilot-first and rollback-ready.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the connector + agent governance model: how connectors expose data, where boundaries apply, and the guardrails for agent development.
  • Requirements Guide — prerequisites (Gemini Enterprise, the data-governance baseline, security/legal alignment, a pilot) with how to verify/implement each.
  • Connector Strategy & Agent Framework — the approval criteria and data-access boundaries for connectors, and the standard framework/guardrails for developing agentic workflows (design, review, deploy, monitor).
  • 5 supporting scripts — connector/agent inventory discovery, boundary/guardrail conformance validation, a connector/agent coverage-and-risk report, safe remediation, and a scope helper.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides plus Best Practices for governed AI expansion; preview capabilities cited or flagged, never invented.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Gemini connectors and agents that expand capability under control — approved connectors, enforced data boundaries, and a governed agent framework — not an ungoverned sprawl.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • GEMCONN-Discovery.ps1 — inventory Gemini Enterprise connectors (data stores) and agents across a
    • GEMCONN-Remediation.ps1 — safe remediation: disable an unapproved connector (data store) or
    • GEMCONN-Report.ps1 — connector/agent coverage-and-risk report with drift versus a saved baseline
    • GEMCONN-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — resolve and confirm the Google Cloud project / location / IAM
    • GEMCONN-Validation.ps1 — confirm connector data-access boundaries and agent-development guardrails

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
